verdict.rationale: Jeeves ships an MCP server that lets AI assistants/autonomous agents pay vendors, submit reimbursements, and query finances (jeeves-docs-13/33/43/47), which is a step toward AI-native automation, and separate docs mention automated invoice/approval flows and automated reminder emails (jeeves-docs-21, jeeves-docs-27). However there is no evidence of a scheduling/background-job mechanism, persistent triggers, or any documented 'run autonomously without user invocation' capability — the MCP tools appear to be invoked per-request by an agent rather than set up as standing background automations. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger configuration, evidence of persistent/background execution, and any hands-on confirmation that agents act without ongoing user prompting.
